fact: Car 6 failed to slow under double yellow flags at T13
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code and Article B 1.8.4b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The telemetry for Car 6 clearly showed that the driver did not make a significant reduction in speed when in the double yellow flag area, as required by the regulations. The penalty is the standard penalty for this offence.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 6 Failing To Slow For Yellow Flags
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
